claude.sample_unit: MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes (plus 10,030 cases in acuity analysis)

links.outcome: Undertriage rate of LLM triage tools on emergency cases
links.effect: PLT undertriage 13.1% vs rPLT 29.8% (P < 0.001); ESI accuracy 57.5% vs 42.8%.
links.quote: PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains.

unlisted_practices: Multidimensional evaluation framework (SAFE-Triage) combining human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge, and simulation for triage AI
